title: Complete catalog decision support and add budget-scaled architecture options
instruction: Remove internal cadence and catalog-origin fields from the public catalog; show useful research, verification, update, and Coverage Gap status; apply the decision-oriented current-versus-near-term structure to every partially researched Topic; document the rapid provisional update lane and independent verification boundary; and publish three budget-scaled architecture diagrams for each system planning option using public historical reference cases and clearly labelled low-confidence analytical estimates.
